comment: Turns the built-in image CAPTCHA on or off for Admin Panel forms.
modal: When **Yes**, the legacy image CAPTCHA is required on the selected admin forms; **No** disables it. Applies to the Admin Panel.

comment: The font used to render the admin CAPTCHA image.
modal: Selects which configured font the CAPTCHA characters are drawn with. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

comment: Which Admin Panel forms display the CAPTCHA.
modal: Selects the admin forms (such as login and forgot password) that require a CAPTCHA. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

comment: When the admin CAPTCHA is shown — e.g. always or after failed attempts.
modal: Chooses when a CAPTCHA is required, such as always or only after a number of failed login attempts. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

comment: How many minutes a displayed admin CAPTCHA stays valid before expiring.
modal: The lifetime, in minutes, of a displayed CAPTCHA before a new one must be generated. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

comment: Whether admin CAPTCHA answers must match letter case.
modal: When **Yes**, the entered CAPTCHA text must match the case of the displayed characters. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

comment: Turns the built-in image CAPTCHA on or off for storefront forms.
modal: When **Yes**, the legacy image CAPTCHA is required on the selected storefront forms; **No** disables it. Can be set per website.

comment: The font used to render the storefront CAPTCHA image.
modal: Selects which configured font the CAPTCHA characters are drawn with. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA on Storefront is Yes. Can be set per website.

comment: When the storefront CAPTCHA is shown — e.g. always or after failed attempts.
modal: Chooses when a CAPTCHA is required, such as always or only after a number of failed attempts. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA on Storefront is Yes. Can be set per website.

comment: How many minutes a displayed storefront CAPTCHA stays valid before expiring.
modal: The lifetime, in minutes, of a displayed CAPTCHA before a new one must be generated. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA on Storefront is Yes. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether storefront CAPTCHA answers must match letter case.
modal: When **Yes**, the entered CAPTCHA text must match the case of the displayed characters. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA on Storefront is Yes. Can be set per website.
